| Weather | Light at noon, in the open | In the shade | A full moon's light | Overworld sight lost |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Clear | 100% | 100% | 100% | none |
| Overcast | 57% | 152% | 58% | none |
| Rain | 41% | 124% | 44% | 2 cells |
| Heavy rain | 28% | 90% | 30% | 4 cells |

Percentages are of the light of a clear sky at the same moment. The shade is where the sun does not reach but the sky does; the brighter it is next to the open ground, the fainter the shadows. The last column is what the weather itself takes from your sight on the overworld; at night its clouds also dim the moon, and with it how far you see by moonlight (see [the overworld](overworld.md)).
